_description: GET /api/refs/search. Query: q (string, 0..=200 chars, empty = most recent), kinds (optional comma list of active kinds, default all five), project_id / workspace_slug (optional filters), limit (1..=50, default 20). Response 200: {items}. Each item: kind, id, label (title), subtitle (optional, one line of context), project and workspace (optional {id, slug, name}), entity_status (the entity's own status, optional). Fields that are absent are omitted, not null. Results are already filtered by the access policy. 400 with the refs_invalid body on a bad query (see errors.json).
